section_summary.evidence_source: 3.1. Preliminary data analyses First of all, the suitability of the data for further statistical analyses was tested. The normality of data distribution was confirmed through the analysis of coefficients of Skewness and Kurtosis. Values of Skewness ranged from −0.16 (BAS-2) to 1.84 (Age), and Kurtosis values between −0.40 (BAS-2) and 4.52 (Age), which do not suggest the presence of serious violation of normal distribution, according to Kline (2005). Furthermore, Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) values ranged between 0.05 (Age) and 1.16 (OAS), which indicates a low probability of multicollinearity issues (Kline, 2005).
